clue.text: Going to extremes in tourist sites, stand up to view and view?

parts.note: to stand up to someone is to confront or face them

indicators.note: going to the extremes of the phrase takes only its very first and very last letters

explanation.surface: A sightseer at tourist attractions is urged to stand up and take in view after view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Going to extremes in' picks the outside letters of 'tourist sites', T and S, which follow FACE. The definition, two views, points to a plural noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Facets are the different aspects or sides of something, so a view and another view are several of them.

clue.text: Car dash from France when chased by US agents

indicators.note: chased by means the agents come after the earlier letters

parts.note: F is the international vehicle code for France
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
the CIA is the American intelligence agency

explanation.surface: A car is driven at speed out of France with American spies in pursuit.
explanation.definitionFit: The fascia is the dashboard of a car, the panel carrying the instruments.

clue.text: Recipe page to have separate entries dividing 'capable for stewing' fruit

indicators.note: the letters split the shuffled word apart by sitting inside it
the two letters go in at separate places rather than together
stewing churns the letters of capable into a new arrangement

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for recipe, from the Latin on prescriptions

explanation.surface: A cookbook page tells you to add things separately to a fruit described as good for stewing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For stewing' rearranges CAPABLE into CABAPLE; 'to have separate entries dividing' then puts R after the C and a second P beside the P, making CRABAPPLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A crab apple is a small sour wild apple, a kind of fruit often made into jelly.

clue.text: In combination, three small goals

parts.note: ter- is the Latin prefix for three used in combined words such as tercentenary
mini means small

explanation.surface: Three little goals scored together in a combination move.
explanation.definitionFit: Termini are end points or destinations, so goals in the sense of places one is heading for.

clue.text: Ruins meals with addition of a touch of cardamom

indicators.note: the extra letter is added into the meals word

parts.note: suppers are evening meals

indicators.note: a touch of a word is just its first letter

explanation.surface: A cook ruins the dinners by adding a little cardamom.
explanation.definitionFit: To scupper a plan is to wreck or sink it, so it ruins it.

clue.text: Bankruptcy court detains troubled arrestee around end of July

indicators.note: detains means the court letters hold the rest inside them
around means the shuffled letters surround the last letter of July
troubled shows the letters of arrestee are disturbed into a new order
the end of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A court holds an agitated prisoner around the end of July.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Troubled' turns ARRESTEE into AREXSTREE with 'around' placing Y at X, and 'detains' puts that between C and T. CAREY STREET is the London street that once housed the bankruptcy court.
explanation.definitionFit: To be 'in Carey Street' is an old British idiom for being bankrupt, after the street housing the bankruptcy courts.

clue.text: Cooked OK, a chip that's made in a Chinese restaurant

definitions.text: that's made in a Chinese restaurant

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters of the following words are worked into a new form

explanation.surface: A chef says a chip cooked well enough is something a Chinese restaurant serves.
explanation.definitionFit: Pak choi is a Chinese leaf vegetable, a common dish in Chinese restaurants.

clue.text: Feeling of weariness for Parisian in most of night

parts.note: en is French for in

indicators.note: most of a word drops its final letter

parts.note: nuit is French for night, the French sense carried over from Parisian

explanation.surface: A Parisian feels tired in the small hours of the night.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Parisian' makes both pieces French: EN for 'in' and NUIT for 'night', cut short by 'most of'.
explanation.definitionFit: Ennui is listless boredom, a jaded tiredness of spirit borrowed from French.

clue.text: It's good sense to embrace a recipe conducive to health

indicators.note: to embrace means the sense word holds the other letters inside

parts.note: sanity means sound judgement or good sense

explanation.surface: It is wise to follow a recipe that is good for you.
explanation.definitionFit: Sanitary means hygienic, relating to conditions that promote health.

clue.text: Celebrities will commandeer international flight

indicators.note: to commandeer is to seize and hold, so the stars take the letter inside

parts.note: stars are celebrities

explanation.surface: Famous people will take over an international plane journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flight' tempts as an aircraft trip, but here it is a flight of steps.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight is a set of steps between floors, that is a staircase.

clue.text: Reset middle of ankle bone, gathering right hip should be made less stiff

indicators.note: gathering means the rearranged letters take in another inside them
reset says the letters are set again in a different arrangement, as a bone is
the middle of a five-letter word is its third letter

parts.note: in means fashionable, the same as hip

explanation.surface: A medic resets a broken ankle and the hip needs loosening up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reset' rearranges K (middle of ANKLE) and BONE into BOKEN; 'gathering' takes R in to make BROKEN.
explanation.definitionFit: New shoes or a horse that are broken in have been worn or worked until supple and no longer stiff.

clue.text: Visionary wise men managed to come back within current year

indicators.note: within means the pieces sit inside the current and year letters

parts.note: I is the symbol for electric current
the Magi are the wise men of the Nativity

indicators.note: coming back means the managed word is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: ran means managed, as in ran a business

explanation.surface: The Magi managed to return home inside the current year.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Visionary' looks like a person with vision, but here it is the adjective meaning fanciful; 'to come back' is the reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Visionary can mean existing only in the imagination, fanciful or unreal.

clue.text: Medicine sorted out Auntie Vi's overwhelming temperature and coughs finally

indicators.note: sorted out tells us the letters are rearranged into order
finally takes the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: A remedy fixes Auntie Vi's high temperature and finally her coughs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sorted out' rearranges AUNTIEVIS with T and the S that ends 'coughs'; 'overwhelming' just says the aunt's letters take the other two into the mix.
explanation.definitionFit: An antitussive is a cough suppressant, a medicine that eases coughing.

clue.text: Robbery in Hythe is traumatic

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A robbery in the Kent seaside town of Hythe is upsetting.
explanation.walkthrough: Hythe is a small town on the Kent coast of England.
explanation.definitionFit: A heist is a robbery, especially a daring raid on a bank or vault.

clue.text: Liquid solvent make-up used by seductive entertainer

parts.note: paint is old slang for cosmetics
a stripper performs a striptease

explanation.surface: A burlesque performer uses some kind of make-up.
explanation.definitionFit: Paint stripper is a solvent fluid used to soften and remove old paint.

clue.text: With pressure everything I chewed in the end disintegrates and softens

parts.note: all means everything
ate means chewed and swallowed

indicators.note: in the end takes the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: Under pressure, everything I chewed finally breaks down and goes soft.
explanation.definitionFit: To palliate is to ease or mitigate, as palliative care eases symptoms without curing them.

clue.text: Publicity goes on in this place over books one supports

indicators.note: goes on means the next piece is added after
in a down entry, over means the first piece sits above the next

parts.note: an ad is a piece of publicity
here means in this place
NT, the New Testament, is a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: An advertisement runs here over a list of books.
explanation.definitionFit: An adherent is a follower or supporter of a cause, so someone who backs it.

clue.text: Yet when old I do fancy being of fixed opinion

indicators.note: fancy as a word for elaborate or reworked tells us the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone says that even in old age they still fancy something, set in their ways.
explanation.definitionFit: Dyed-in-the-wool describes someone thoroughgoing and unchangeable in their beliefs.

clue.text: Lidless can cuts fingers?

indicators.note: lidless removes the top letter of the can word

parts.note: a tin is a can
dices means cuts into cubes

explanation.surface: An opened tin without its lid can slice your fingers.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that fingers are index fingers, so the plural is a cheeky example.
explanation.definitionFit: Indices is a plural of index, and the index finger is the forefinger.

clue.text: Performing advanced part for the audience, showing continuing success

parts.note: on means performing, as on stage
A is an abbreviation for advanced, as in A level

indicators.note: for the audience means the part word is heard rather than written

parts.note: a role is an actor's part

explanation.surface: An actor playing a leading part for an audience is doing well.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on a roll is an idiom for enjoying a run of successes.

clue.text: What holds matters pending within yard

parts.note: intra- is the Latin prefix meaning within

explanation.surface: Something keeping unresolved business inside a yard.
explanation.definitionFit: An in-tray on a desk holds papers waiting to be dealt with.

clue.text: Antelope discovered in European territory

parts.note: land is territory

explanation.surface: A wild antelope is found in some European country.
explanation.definitionFit: The eland is a large African antelope with spiral horns.

clue.text: Scottish town contributes to regional loans

indicators.note: contributes to says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A Scottish town puts money into local lending.
explanation.definitionFit: Alloa is a town in Clackmannanshire in central Scotland, on the Forth.

clue.text: Number one tense is reversed into position

indicators.note: is reversed applies to the whole string of pieces, read back to front

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
taut means tense or tight

explanation.surface: A grammar note: the first-person tense is turned round into a different position.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number one' looks like a single unit but splits into two abbreviations, and 'is reversed' turns the whole chain round, not just the last word.
explanation.definitionFit: A situation is a position or set of circumstances one finds oneself in.

clue.text: Broad vote includes Conservative in charge

indicators.note: includes means the vote word holds the next letter inside

parts.note: to elect is to vote in

explanation.surface: A wide-ranging election takes in a Tory in command.
explanation.definitionFit: Eclectic means drawing on a wide range of sources, so broad in scope.

clue.text: Hat, one in a row?

definitions.meaning: someone in a boat with oars, one rowing; the question mark signals the play on row as a line

explanation.walkthrough: 'In a row' suggests a line of things, but it means rowing a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A boater is a straw hat with a flat crown, and also someone who goes boating.

clue.text: Conveyance used by football clubs, for a fee

definitions.meaning: a conveying or handing over of property from one person to another

definitions.text: used by football clubs, for a fee
definitions.meaning: football clubs buy and sell players' moves between clubs for a fee

explanation.definitionFit: A transfer is a legal handing over of property, and in football the sale of a player to another club.

clue.text: Stylish young woman residing in city outskirts

indicators.note: residing in means the young woman sits inside the other letters
the outskirts of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: a lass is a young woman

explanation.surface: A smart young woman lives on the edge of town.
explanation.definitionFit: Classy means stylish or elegant, showing high quality.
